article.title: Unofficial Results of the 2026 UAW International Officer Election
article.author: Justin Mayhugh
article.content: Members of the United Auto Workers have cast their ballots by mail for the union’s top officers for the second time in the union’s 91-year history. Newly elected UAW International Officers will be sworn in on Friday, October 16 and will serve a four- year term. UAW International Officer Election Results: International President: Shawn Fain International Secretary-Treasurer: Brandon Campbell International Vice-President: Laura Dickerson, Kevin Gotinsky, Ryan Hiestand Region 1 Regional Director: LaShawn English Region 1A Regional Director: Mark DePaoli Region 1D Regional Director: Scott Zuckschwerdt Region 2B Regional Director: David Green Region 4 Regional Director: Lucas DeSpain Region 6 Regional Director: Mike Miller Region 8 Regional Director: Tim Smith Region 9 Regional Director: James Lakeman Region 9A Regional Director: Brandon Mancilla
